assignments.reason: Teshuvah (repentance) in this Torah is the essential spiritual process that produces tefillin/bushah. Its nature is the return to God — the same domain of holy self-awareness and shame before the Creator that defines Package 1. The Torah states explicitly: 'al yedei ha-korban, haynu al yedei ha-teshuvah, zakha le-bchinat tefillin.' Teshuvah belongs to the domain of holy shame/awe, not to Torah-study or speech.

This is the active process of teshuvah — making repentance and removing foolishness. Its essential nature is the teshuvah/bushah domain: 'ke-she-oseh teshuvah u-mesir mimenu ha-tipshut, ve-nitosaf bo sikhlo, azai hu mitbayesh be-yoter.' It IS teshuvah in action, which belongs in the tefillin/bushah cluster.

assignments.node_id: נתוסף בו שכלו. אזי הוא מתביש ביותר, ונתגלה הבושה על פניו
assignments.reason: This is the state of increased intellect leading to intensified shame revealed on the face — which is precisely the or ha-tefillin. Its essential nature is the manifestation of bushah/tefillin. The Torah explicitly equates this state with 'bchinat tefillin': 've-ha-bushah ha-zot hu bchinat or ha-tefillin she-nitgaleh al panav be-mitzcho.'

assignments.node_id: נכנס בו בושה גדולה על גדל פשעיו, כנגד רב ושליט עקרא ושרשא דכל עלמין
assignments.reason: This is the great shame that enters a person upon recognizing the magnitude of their sins before God. Its essential nature IS bushah — the core concept of Package 1. This is the activated form of the inner shame before it becomes revealed on the face (or ha-tefillin).

This node describes the act of praying and seeking forgiveness — its essential nature is tefilah (prayer). While it is caused BY bushah, the act itself IS prayer. The Torah states: 'al yedei ha-bushah hu mitpalel u-mevakesh mechilah al avonotav.' The node belongs in the prayer domain by what it IS, not by what causes it.

assignments.node_id: מתחיל לדבר בחמימות שבלב, דבר אמת שבלב. וכשמדבר בינו לבין קונו דברי אמת שבלבו, בהתעוררות בתשובה, ורואה פחיתותיו וגדלת הבורא. כי עד עכשו השליך חטאתיו אחר כתפיו ולא עין בהם, ועכשו כשיודע אותם
assignments.reason: This node describes speaking with the warmth of the heart (chamimut ha-lev) in words of truth — the activated form of the gevurot-speech. The Torah places this in the context of raising dibur to its root in the gevurot: 'u-matchil le-daber be-chamimut she-ba-lev, dvar emet she-ba-lev.' Its essential nature is the gevurot-powered speech that emerges when dibur is elevated to its source.

assignments.node_id: חדוד שכלו, וחדוש שכלו, שקבל על־ידי התורה שנקרא י"ו כנ"ל
assignments.reason: The sharpening and renewal of intellect received through Torah (called yud-vav = luchot). The additions file already placed luchot in Package 4. This node's essential nature is Torah-intellect sharpened through the luchot — the same domain as the gevurot/Torah cluster. It PRODUCES bushah/tefillin, but it IS Torah-intellect (the mochin received through the gevurot-Torah chain).

This is the act of elevating and rectifying the dibur (speech). Its essential nature is dibur — the very subject of Package 2. The Torah opens section 2 with: 've-i efshar lavo li-bchinat tefillin ella she-ya'aleh et ha-dibur vi-ytakneh.' While it causes tefillin, it IS an action upon dibur, belonging to the speech domain.

Binding and elevating the dibur to its root — this is essentially the same as 'she-ya'aleh et ha-dibur.' Its essential nature is the process of speech-elevation, squarely in the dibur domain. The Torah states this in the closing verse exposition: 'ba-yam hu bchinat dibur, ke-she-tkasher ve-ta'aleh et ha-dibur le-shorshah.'

Elevating dibur to its source — this is the same concept as the two nodes above, expressed as the goal/outcome of Torah study at night. Its essential nature is the elevation of speech, belonging to the dibur/yam domain.
The dibur ascends — this is the rectified state of speech. Its essential nature IS dibur in its elevated form. Belongs in the speech domain.

assignments.node_id: נתתקן הדבור, וקץ כל בשר יטבע בנקבא דתהומא רבא
assignments.reason: The rectification of dibur and the drowning of ketz kol basar — this is a compound outcome node, but its essential nature is the rectified state of speech (nitaken ha-dibur). The drowning of the evil force is the consequence of the speech being fixed. The dominant concept here is dibur restored to holiness.

assignments.node_id: נמשך חוט של חסד, ואז הבקר אור וכו, ואז הדבור עולה
assignments.reason: The thread of chesed is drawn, morning dawns, and the dibur ascends. This is a compound effect-node describing the cascade result of night-Torah study. Its endpoint and essential nature is the ascent of dibur. While it mentions chesed/boker, the Torah frames these as the mechanism by which dibur rises. The node's core identity is the restored speech.

assignments.node_id: כשהוא כופף את רוחו סערה, דהינו שהוא נוטל ממנו כל הדבורים שנפלו לתוכו
assignments.reason: Bending the storm-wind by taking back all the diburim that fell into it. This is the active process of recovering fallen speech from the domain of evil. Its essential nature is the rescue and restoration of dibur — the fallen words being reclaimed for holiness. The Torah states: 'she-hu notel mimenu kol ha-diburim she-naflu le-tokho.' This is a speech-domain concept.

The verse 'He stills the storm to a whisper' (Psalms 107:29) — in this Torah, d'mamah (silence/stillness) is the rectified state of speech after the storm-wind is subdued. The essential nature is the perfected/peaceful state of the speech-domain: the sea at rest, dibur restored to holy quietness. This is the positive outcome within the speech dimension.

Torah in this teaching is identified with the mountains (harim) in the cosmic stack, and the luchot are its root. The additions file already placed luchot in Package 4. Torah is the instrument through which the gevurot (articulations/intellectual sharpening) operate. In this Torah, Torah is equated with harim and with yud-vav (the luchot), both belonging to the gevurot cluster. It is the source-text that powers the gevurot-speech chain.

Torat chesed (Torah of kindness) is a specific mode of Torah — Torah studied with the quality of chesed/Avraham. Its essential nature remains Torah. The Torah states: 'al yedei ha-torat chesed nit'aleh ha-dibur.' While it produces the elevation of dibur, it IS Torah, belonging in the Torah/gevurot domain.

assignments.node_id: תורה שלומדין בצר לאדם, בעניות ובדחקות
assignments.reason: Torah studied in distress and poverty — this is Torah study in a specific condition, but its essential nature is Torah. The distress/poverty condition is a bechina of laylah (Package 6), but the study itself is Torah. The Torah states: 'tikun ha-dibur hu al yedei ha-Torah she-lomdin ba-tzar la-adam.' The cause-node is the Torah study, not the condition. It IS Torah.

Learning Torah at night — again, the essential nature is Torah study. The night condition is a circumstantial modifier; the node itself IS Torah learning. It causes the thread of chesed and the elevation of dibur, but by nature it belongs to the Torah/gevurot domain.

Water on the mountains — the Torah explicitly equates this with Torah: 'u-mayim al he-harim, zo bchinat Torah, she-al yadah nit'orer chesed Avraham.' The mountains ARE Torah (she-hu meromam) and Avraham is called a mountain. The node's essential nature is Torah in its cosmic-structure form.

assignments.node_id: תורה, שעל ידה נתעורר מדת אברהם
assignments.reason: Torah through which the quality of Avraham is awakened — this is Torah with its chesed-awakening quality. Its essential nature is Torah, placed in the gevurot/Torah cluster.

The awakening of chesed Avraham — in this Torah, chesed Avraham is the quality drawn through Torah study at night (the 'thread of chesed' from Chagigah 12b). While chesed is a distinct sefiratic quality, in this Torah it is entirely framed as the product and companion of Torah study: 'ha-lomed Torah ba-laylah, moshkhin alav chut shel chesed ba-yom.' Avraham = har (mountain) = Torah. The boker de-Avraham is the dawn that Torah study brings. In this Torah's framework, chesed Avraham has no independent package — it belongs with the Torah/gevurot cluster that generates it.

assignments.node_id: להמשיך קדשת שבת, לקדש ימי החל
assignments.reason: Drawing the holiness of Shabbat to sanctify the weekdays — its essential nature is Shabbat-kedushah. In this Torah, Shabbat is explicitly equated with bushah (Package 1: 'Shabbat — bchinat bushah'). This node is the active extension of Shabbat-holiness into the week. Since Shabbat itself is assigned to Package 1, the act of extending its kedushah shares the same essential nature.

assignments.node_id: לפי הקדשה שמקדש ימי החל, כן נדחה זהמת הנחש, קץ כל בשר, שהוא בחינת רוח סערה
assignments.reason: According to the sanctification of the weekdays, the serpent's pollution (ketz kol basar / rua'h se'arah) is repelled. This is a compound effect node describing the result of extending Shabbat-kedushah. Its essential nature is the Shabbat-kedushah-powered repelling of evil — the triumph of the Shabbat/bushah domain over the serpent's domain. The driving concept is the kedushah of Shabbat (Package 1), not the evil force being defeated.
